claimLevel: MODEL_ONLY rebuild replays (rebuilt-runtime) of a DEVICE_MEASURED night
question: Given n5b's own touches, does the rebuilt FNaF 4 (pinned 57b48ac1-615f2ea0) play Night 5 as the phone did -- Fredbear landing R at 6 s, L at 9 s, R at 15 s and R at 21 s of level time, no landing on the other roll ticks to 36 s, and the black onset at level 39.25 s -- at some seed, and at exactly one?

reading.verdict: Given n5b's own touches, the rebuilt FNaF 4 plays its Night 5 as the phone did at 6 of 65,536 seeds: every roll tick from 3 s to 36 s (Fredbear R 6 s, L 9 s, R 15 s, R 21 s, silent otherwise) and the black onset inside its window. The seed is not identified: n5b's four landings and eight silences leave six.
reading.separation: The landings did the separating, not the death: 14 kept seeds match all twelve ticks and 6 of them die; all 207 deaths among the 2,399 kept seeds set `gameover` at the same update, 2389, so under n5b's touches the death time does not depend on the seed.
reading.validity: No stage-2 row errored, and all 2,419 traces (the 20 validity seeds among them) show the predeclared prefix draw counts: the stage-1 reading off the generator held on every seed replayed.
reading.exploratory: Not under the rule: all six matches set `gameover` at update 2389, 34 updates (0.57 s) after the phone's first all-black frame (2355); the phone's jumpscare began 0.53 s after that frame, so `gameover` may mark the jumpscare rather than the black.
reading.consequence: The first time a FNaF 4 phone night is reproduced in the rebuild at the encounter level from its own touches (landing latencies borrowed from FNaF 2). A FNaF 4 seed measurement needs a night with more heard landings, or its seed read off the phone.

reproducer.scan: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=2500M -p MemorySwapMax=0 -p CPUWeight=10 -- nice -n 19 node packages/propose/bin/recompile/fnaf4-run-seed.ts scan --predeclaration <this file> --binary <pinned>/Chowdren --assets <pinned>/Assets.dat --out <outside the repository> --jobs 3; then decide --results <out>/results.jsonl
